prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body dual-body portrait: left leg tier L3, right leg tier L3, collarbone boundary. ONE woman standing, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, the camera set back so her whole body fits in the frame from the top of her head to her feet, her face still sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in banba makeup — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, long teased neon-pink and lime hair, a fierce, playful expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big silver hoop with a small pearl drop.

Physique: A towering, immensely powerful woman standing full height on long legs, never short or squat, the body of a world's strongest woman under a thick layer of soft fat — enormously broad thick shoulders, massive arms, a colossal chest, a huge barrel torso with a big round belly, no waist at all, her left thigh and her entire left calf, all the way down to just above the ankle bone, are part of the vessel above; her right thigh and her entire right calf, all the way down to just above the ankle bone, are part of the vessel above.

Material body: below the collarbones — her whole chest, both arms, both hands, belly, hips, her left thigh and her entire left calf, all the way down to just above the ankle bone, are part of the vessel above, and her right thigh and her entire right calf, all the way down to just above the ankle bone, are part of the vessel above — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass. The vessel is completely filled with clear turquoise water from the collarbone line down through whichever leg parts remain part of the vessel, with no hollow space and no air gap anywhere inside it. The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Both arms below the shoulder, both hands, and every finger and knuckle, are the same solid clear glass as the rest of the vessel, with no skin anywhere on them. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through the whole filled volume — passing beside and between both hands and every finger, rising through her whole chest up to the collarbone line itself, winding around both hips, and drifting through whichever thigh and leg sections remain glass, never crowding, always with open water around each one.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left leg transition: On the left leg, the glass continues, unbroken, down through the entire calf, narrowing naturally with the shape of the leg the whole way down, and ends only at the very last possible point — exactly just above the ankle bone, immediately before the bone itself would show — in a perfectly flat, deliberately cut cross-section, exactly like a clean slice cut through a cast-glass sculpture, never any higher up the leg than that exact point. Her real left ankle bone and foot are a separate thing entirely: they simply begin at that same low point, flush against the cut face of the glass immediately above them, sharing nothing with it — an ordinary, undisturbed real ankle and foot, with real skin, real pores and fine grain, warm in tone, completely opaque, never itself cut, never marked, as if it had always continued naturally from there.

Right leg transition: On the right leg, the glass continues, unbroken, down through the entire calf, narrowing naturally with the shape of the leg the whole way down, and ends only at the very last possible point — exactly just above the ankle bone, immediately before the bone itself would show — in a perfectly flat, deliberately cut cross-section, exactly like a clean slice cut through a cast-glass sculpture, never any higher up the leg than that exact point. Her real right ankle bone and foot are a separate thing entirely: they simply begin at that same low point, flush against the cut face of the glass immediately above them, sharing nothing with it — an ordinary, undisturbed real ankle and foot, with real skin, real pores and fine grain, warm in tone, completely opaque, never itself cut, never marked, as if it had always continued naturally from there.

Left leg (real): her real left ankle and foot, natural skin texture. her real left foot stands in a real extreme platform stiletto sandal.

Right leg (real): her real right ankle and foot, natural skin texture. her real right foot stands in a real extreme platform stiletto sandal.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep forest green on one side and a soft blush pink on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle — glowing evenly, marked with a few thin dark vertical lines spaced evenly across it so the bending of those lines inside her material body is unmistakable, and a glossy dark floor beneath her feet.

Pose: standing tall, body angled 45 degrees, feet planted apart, her left hand (solid glass) resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand (solid glass) relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods her material body from behind, so green light passes through one side and pink light passes through the other, the vertical lines clearly visible bending inside the glass. A soft frontal light falls on her face, ears and any real leg parts. A thin cool rim light traces her whole figure. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
